'''Blicci-flavored ice''' was a dessert. The catering company [[Estimable Epicures]] served [[blicci]]-flavored ice at a reception hosted by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] [[Ritinki]] and [[Vop]] aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship|Ithorian herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]''.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>
